      "keystrokes": "cat << 'EOF' > /root/calculate_rmse.py
import netCDF4 as nc
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from datetime import datetime, timedelta

# Load observations
obs_df = pd.read_csv('/root/field_temp_oxy.csv')
obs_df['datetime'] = pd.to_datetime(obs_df['datetime'])

# Load simulation
ds = nc.Dataset('/root/output/output.nc')
time_var = ds.variables['time']
time_units = time_var.units
# time_units is usually 'hours since 2009-01-01 12:00:00' or similar
# Convert netCDF time to datetime
sim_times = nc.num2date(time_var[:], units=time_units)
sim_times = np.array([datetime(t.year, t.month, t.day, t.hour, t.minute, t.second) for t in sim_times])

temp_sim = ds.variables['temp'][:]
z_sim = ds.variables['z'][:]

# Filter observations within simulation time range
obs_df = obs_df[(obs_df['datetime'] >= sim_times[0]) & (obs_df['datetime'] <= sim_times[-1])]

# Interpolate simulation to observation points
sim_vals = []
for i, row in obs_df.iterrows():
    t_idx = np.argmin(np.abs(sim_times - row['datetime']))
    # z_sim is height from bottom, but obs depth is from surface
    # Max depth at this time
    max_z = z_sim[t_idx, -1]
    obs_height = max_z - row['depth']
    
    # Get temperature profile at this time
    # Filter out masked values if any
    z_profile = z_sim[t_idx, :]
    temp_profile = temp_sim[t_idx, :]
    
    # Valid layers (where z is not masked or NaN)
    mask = ~np.isnan(z_profile)
    if hasattr(z_profile, 'mask'):
        mask = mask & (~z_profile.mask)
        
    z_valid = z_profile[mask]
    temp_valid = temp_profile[mask]
    
    if obs_height < z_valid[0]:
        sim_val = temp_valid[0]
    elif obs_height > z_valid[-1]:
        sim_val = temp_valid[-1]
    else:
        sim_val = np.interp(obs_height, z_valid, temp_valid)
    
    sim_vals.append(sim_val)

obs_df['sim_temp'] = sim_vals
rmse = np.sqrt(np.mean((obs_df['temp'] - obs_df['sim_temp'])**2))
print(f'RMSE: {rmse}')

ds.close()
EOF
